attributes.action: All schools, public transport and homes to be installed with air conditioning.
attributes.background: I would like the government to consider and install air conditioning into all homes, schools, hospitals and public transport across the UK by the summer of 2027. It is a major health risk when temperatures soar to 37 plus degrees.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023

Mandate working a/c and heating systems on all new public transport vehicles
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023

Fund free air-conditioning installation and maintenance in all homes
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776610
